ABOUT OUR GYM

WELCOME TO THE FIT MUSCLE GYM

Located at Mishri Lal Chauraha in Dabauli West, Kanpur, THE FIT MUSCLE GYM is a dedicated fitness community built on discipline, encouragement, and honest daily effort.

BUILT ON CONSISTENCY

Every rep counts. Our members train together with shared energy, mutual respect, and focused guidance.

At THE FIT MUSCLE GYM, we believe fitness is not a temporary trend—it is a sustainable lifestyle. Whether you are stepping into a gym for the very first time or striving to surpass your personal bests, our environment is designed to keep you focused and motivated.

Our facility provides a comprehensive selection of strength, functional, and isolation machines alongside free weights. With direct coaching from experienced trainer Krishna Gupta, you learn proper technique, stay accountable, and make genuine progress in a friendly, supportive environment.

Consistent Training

Structured workout routines and habit-building principles tailored to your everyday schedule.

Form & Safety

Focus on safe lifting mechanics, injury prevention, and continuous posture guidance on the floor.

Supportive Community

A motivating local atmosphere where every member is encouraged to push forward and grow.

Dual Daily Shifts

Convenient morning (5:30–10:00 AM) and evening (5:00–10:00 PM) hours to fit your daily routine.
